# /crav1-open-pr

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [From commit to merge](../../from-commit.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-open-pr/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Open a pull request for the current change branch (push with explicit yes).

Push the change branch only after an explicit yes, then open one pull request (no merge, no commit). Body is What / why, Spec links, Verify, and a Work item section when `work-item.md` exists. On Windows, a multi-line Azure DevOps description is passed as `--description "@<file>"` (UTF-8 without BOM). May name [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md) and does not run it. Next explicit ask to merge is [`/crav1-merge-pr`](crav1-merge-pr.md).

1.64.0: the base is the head's `(into …)` branch, then the repo's `Merges into` branch (also from a sibling spec repo), then the default branch. The slug is also found from a spec that lists the head branch.

1.66.0: a push rejected because the remote branch moved says to pull with `git pull --no-rebase`, resolve conflicts, and push again. Never a rebase or a force-push.

1.68.0: the into step is offered and written: a head that split off another spec branch gets one yes/no question, and a sub-branch's PR goes into its spec branch.

## Runs when

Commits exist; want a pull request. Called by the user.

## Prompts

Prompt budget: 1 (the most prompts in one run, the closing yes included). A prompt may hold several questions. See the asking rule in `crav1.mdc`.

## Reads

In short: The change branch, the spec, and `verify.md`.

Reads the change branch, the spec folder, `verify.md`, `work-item.md` when it exists, and the `Merges into` cell in `docs/system/repos.md` and the spec's Branch list for the base.

## Writes

In short: A push of the change branch and one pull request, after an explicit yes, and `(PR <n>)` on the spec's Match `Branch:` entry.

Writes one pull request after an explicit yes to push. With the URL, adds `(PR <n>)` to the head's Match `Branch:` entry in the spec (1.75.0), uncommitted.

## Does not

Leaves new commits and the merge alone.

Limits and exceptions: names [`/crav1-review-pr`](crav1-review-pr.md) and [`/crav1-merge-pr`](crav1-merge-pr.md) and does not run them.
